learned_rules: Treat tomato and lettuce as immutable positive visual anchors unless a later explicit review replaces them.
A food icon must be immediately recognizable at native 16x16 size, not only when enlarged.
Prefer a compact, coherent silhouette with natural asymmetry over generic circles, rods, or colored blobs.
Use characteristic anatomy of the specific food item so adjacent products remain distinguishable without labels.
Preserve convincing volume through a restrained highlight-to-shadow range instead of flat fills or plastic gloss.
Use a compact palette and colored outlines consistent with the approved anchors.
Previously rejected pixel layouts must never silently return as final output.
If the quality gate fails, mark the asset as needing refinement instead of publishing it as final.
